notes:
Summary: StrandShift is a realtime personalization and bidding platform: very latency- and cost-sensitive. Primary flows: low-latency chat for agent-assisted bidding (p50 < 50ms desired), candidate reranking for top-K personalization (throughput bursts to 800-1,200 qps), and cosine-embedding store for fast semantic lookup. They are highly interested in Redwood's Dedicated pools for predictable latency, but procurement wants to compare hosted + Optimize recommendations for unit cost savings.

Key technical constraints / asks:
- Latency SLOs: p50 <= 50ms, p90 <= 120ms for chat flows; reranker target p95 <= 200ms at 500 qps sustained.
- Throughput: baseline steady 200 qps, peak 1,200 qps for flash traffic windows.
- Accuracy budget: quantization must not degrade reranker NDCG by more than 1.5 percentage points.
- Context lengths: chat history ~ 512 tokens typical, some sessions up to 2,048 tokens (need KV cache behavior clarity).
- Security: VPC endpoint, SSO (SAML), customer-managed KMS, 1-year audit log retention, EU data residency for EU customers.

POC / Evaluation plan (agreed):
- 48-hour perf sweep: compare baseline FP16 model on dedicated pool vs int4/4-bit quantized variant using Redwood Optimize suggestions. Measure p50/p90/p99, tail latency spikes, token throughput, cost/1k requests.
- Enable prefix/KV caching on chat-heavy traffic to test latency win for repeated contexts.
- Exercise smart routing fallback: primary model -> cheaper quantized fallback when Dedicated burst capacity reached.
- Generate evaluation prompts (StrandShift supplied) and run automated quality checks (delta NDCG on reranker + sample human eval for chat coherence).
